definitions.explanation: Spending more money than usual, often as a special treat or gesture of generosity. The most common modern usage.

definitions.gloss: exerting oneself; rousing oneself to action
definitions.explanation: Summoning up energy, courage, or determination to tackle something. Composed of 奮 (rouse/stir up) + 発 (emit/express).

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{奮発|ふんぱつ}してステーキを{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I splurged and had steak today.

examples.japanese: {誕生日|たんじょうび}だから{奮発|ふんぱつ}して{高|たか}いワインを{買|か}った。
examples.english: Since it's my birthday, I splurged and bought an expensive wine.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{奮発|ふんぱつ}して{家族|かぞく}{全員|ぜんいん}を{旅行|りょこう}に{連|つ}れて{行|い}ってくれた。
examples.english: My father splurged and took the whole family on a trip.

examples.japanese: ここで{奮発|ふんぱつ}して{頑張|がんば}らないと{合格|ごうかく}できない。
examples.english: If I don't push myself hard here, I won't pass.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}たちは{監督|かんとく}の{言葉|ことば}に{奮発|ふんぱつ}して{試合|しあい}に{臨|のぞ}んだ。
examples.english: The players roused themselves with the coach's words and headed into the match.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}に{直面|ちょくめん}しても{奮発|ふんぱつ}して{乗|の}り{越|こ}えよう。
examples.english: Even when facing difficulties, let's rally ourselves and overcome them.

notes:
USAGE:
{奮発|ふんぱつ} is most commonly used as a suru-verb ({奮発|ふんぱつ}する). In modern usage, sense 1 (splurging) is far more common than sense 2 (exerting oneself). The spending sense typically implies a happy, voluntary decision to spend more than usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奮発|ふんぱつ}して{買|か}う (splurge and buy)
- ちょっと{奮発|ふんぱつ}する (splurge a little)
- {思|おも}い{切|き}って{奮発|ふんぱつ}する (decide to splurge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{贅沢|ぜいたく}する means "to be extravagant" and focuses on luxury itself, while {奮発|ふんぱつ}する emphasizes the decision to spend more than usual as a special occasion.
